message.content:
Using integration by parts:

\[
\int -\operatorname{atan}(3x)\,dx
= -\left[x\operatorname{atan}(3x) - \int x\cdot \frac{3}{1+9x^2}\,dx\right]
\]

\[
\int x\cdot \frac{3}{1+9x^2}\,dx
= \frac{1}{6}\ln(1+9x^2)
\]

So,

\[
\int -\operatorname{atan}(3x)\,dx
= -x\operatorname{atan}(3x) + \frac{1}{6}\ln(1+9x^2) + C
\]

<answer>
-x*atan(3*x) + (1/6)*ln(1+9*x**2) + C
</answer>
